H.1501.v: https://www.lr.edu/admission-and-aid/guarantee Lenoir Rhyne University recently implemented the LRU Tuition Free Guarantee, an institutional financial aid initiative that provides eligible new first year and transfer undergraduate students from North Carolina and South Carolina with family adjusted gross incomes of $100,000 or less full coverage of tuition through grants and scholarships. The program is structured as a last-dollar guarantee and is renewable for up to eight semesters of full-time undergraduate study, with the goal of increasing affordability, reducing student loan debt, and expanding access to higher education.
